create_ListDataset: create a ListDataset wrapping an existing dataset with optional sizes list
iterate_ListDataset: iterate over all samples in a ListDataset using its __iter__ method
collate_ListDataset: collate a batch of samples by returning them as-is via collater
query_sizes_ListDataset: query the sizes property of a ListDataset to get the sizes list
get_num_tokens_ListDataset: get the number of tokens at a given index using num_tokens
